description: This file defines functions and types for handling camera snapshots and clips, including payload parsing, file path generation, and URL downloading with security checks.

methods.name: parseCameraSnapPayload
methods.description: Parses an unknown value into a CameraSnapPayload object, validating required fields.

methods.name: parseCameraClipPayload
methods.description: Parses an unknown value into a CameraClipPayload object, validating required fields.

methods.name: cameraTempPath
methods.description: Generates a temporary file path for camera snap or clip, based on options.

methods.name: writeUrlToFile
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and writes it to a file, with security and size checks.

methods.name: writeBase64ToFile
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string and writes it to a file.

methods.name: requireNodeRemoteIp
methods.description: Validates and returns the remote IP address, ensuring it is provided.

methods.name: writeCameraPayloadToFile
methods.description: Writes camera payload (URL or base64) to a file, handling different payload types.

methods.name: writeCameraClipPayloadToFile
methods.description: Creates a file for a camera clip payload and writes the payload data to it.
